description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for configuring and managing search spaces in 5G NR PDCCH monitoring, including SearchSpace IDs, types, configurations, and related parameters as per 3GPP TS 38.331 and TS 38.213 specifications.

classes.name: search_space_configuration
classes.description: Represents configuration parameters for a search space in PDCCH monitoring, including identifiers, DCI formats, periodicity, slot offset, duration, and monitoring symbols.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two search_space_configuration objects.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the SearchSpace ID.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_id
methods.description: Sets the SearchSpace ID for non-SearchSpace#0 instances.

methods.name: get_coreset_id
methods.description: Returns the CORESET ID associated with the SearchSpace.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_coreset_id
methods.description: Sets the CORESET ID for non-SearchSpace#0 instances.

methods.name: is_search_space0
methods.description: Checks if the SearchSpace is of type 0.

methods.name: is_common_search_space
methods.description: Checks if the SearchSpace is common or UE-specific.

methods.name: get_ss0_index
methods.description: Returns the index of SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_nof_candidates
methods.description: Sets the number of PDCCH candidates for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_nof_candidates
methods.description: Returns the number of PDCCH candidates.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitored_dci_formats
methods.description: Sets the DCI formats monitored in non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_monitored_dci_formats
methods.description: Returns the DCI formats monitored.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_slot_periodicity
methods.description: Sets the periodicity in slots for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_monitoring_slot_periodicity
methods.description: Returns the periodicity in slots.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_slot_offset
methods.description: Sets the slot offset for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_monitoring_slot_offset
methods.description: Returns the slot offset.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_duration
methods.description: Sets the duration in slots for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in slots.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_symbols_within_slot
methods.description: Sets the monitoring symbols within slot for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_monitoring_symbols_within_slot
methods.description: Returns the monitoring symbols within slot.

methods.name: get_first_symbol_index
methods.description: Returns the first monitoring symbol index.
